name: CombatProjectile
src_typeComment: Simple straight-line projectile spawned by RangedAttack in Projectile mode. Deliberately not the same class as Toolkit.Mechanics.TowerDefense.TDProjectile — that one homes onto a specific target and is safe if the target is destroyed mid-flight; this one just flies straight and deals a hit on first contact, matching how a player/enemy combat projectile (arrow, thrown weapon) typically behaves. Requires a Rigidbody (kept kinematic) because this moves via direct transform manipulation, not physics forces — Unity only raises trigger callbacks for a collider pair where at least one side has a Rigidbody, so without this, a projectile would silently pass through any target that also has no Rigidbody (the common case for static scenery/dummies).

src_serialized.name: lifetime
src_serialized.tooltip: Self-destroys after this many seconds even if it never hits anything.
